# mcrl command reference

```text
mcrl is a command-line client for the Mackerel API.

Output is always JSON: indented and colored on a terminal, compact when piped.
Use --jq to filter it. Errors go to stderr and are reflected in the exit code
(see "mcrl help exit-codes").

Global flags:
      --color string       colorize JSON: auto, always or never (env: MCRL_COLOR, NO_COLOR)
      --compact            print compact JSON even on a terminal
      --debug              log HTTP requests and responses to stderr (env: MCRL_DEBUG)
      --dry-run            print the request that would be sent and exit
      --jq string          filter the JSON output with a jq expression; strings are printed raw
      --no-input           never prompt (env: MCRL_NO_INPUT)
  -o, --output string      output format: json or jsonl (env: MCRL_OUTPUT)
      --profile string     profile to use (env: MCRL_PROFILE)
      --timeout duration   timeout for each HTTP request (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
```

## Help topics

### mcrl help environment

```text
Environment variables:

  MACKEREL_APIKEY   API key (overrides the key stored for the profile)
  MCRL_API_BASE     API base URL (default https://api.mackerelio.com)
  MCRL_PROFILE      profile to use
  MCRL_CONFIG       path of the config file
  MCRL_CACHE_DIR    cache directory
  MCRL_OUTPUT       default output format (json or jsonl)
  MCRL_COLOR        auto, always or never
  NO_COLOR          disable colors when set
  MCRL_NO_INPUT     never prompt when set
  MCRL_DEBUG        log HTTP requests and responses to stderr
  HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY  proxy settings
```

### mcrl help exit-codes

```text
Exit codes:

  0    success
  1    other error (including 5xx responses after retries)
  2    usage error (bad flags or arguments, confirmation needed without --yes)
  3    authentication or authorization error (no API key, HTTP 401, HTTP 403)
  4    not found (HTTP 404, or no resource matched a name)
  5    invalid input or conflict (HTTP 400, 409, 413, or a name matched several resources)
  6    rate limited (HTTP 429 after retries)
  7    network error (connection failure, timeout)
  130  interrupted (Ctrl-C)
```
